description: Production source baselines approved for exact-SHA release verification. A baseline is the commit whose build is proven to be live. `verifier.historical` pins the baseline's own provenance verifier by git blob id and sha256; `verifier.currentPolicy` pins the trusted main verifier the binding was reviewed against (sha256 of the LF bytes). A verifier at either side that does not match fails closed. Adding or changing an entry is a provenance-critical change.

baselines.evidence: All 94 served files byte-identical to a clean LF build of this commit (read-only inventory, 2026-11-25).
